entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-25
entry.content:

    .NET 9 Servicing

    .NET 9 Servicing
  • On applying Resize (Larger Text) "Save button" is getting truncated in Task Screen: A11y_.NET 9 template_Task_Resize #30829
    .NET 9 Servicing

    .NET 9 Servicing
